laws.gate_check: computed background + text contrast on served page
laws.name: obsidian ground
laws.rule: black-with-depth background, white text, high contrast; no white/light/pastel/matte-flat surfaces

laws.name: living depth
laws.rule: every interactive element layered: shadow + base + multi-line rim; flat 2D fails

laws.name: ignition
laws.rule: white light at rest; hover/touch/focus ignites in the element's own color only; glow has no other job; a colored body at rest fails (Signature is obsidian, never white)

laws.gate_check: adjacency scan of colored elements in DOM order
laws.name: color flow
laws.rule: purple -> indigo blue (852 Hz) -> emerald green (639 Hz) -> gold (528 Hz; yellow in some icon cases) -> orange (417 Hz) -> red (396 Hz) -> magenta (963 Hz, crown) -> back to purple (purple leads, magenta crowns and wraps, Law 10: one global sequence per page, richest shades); groupings of 3 or 5 or any consecutive run keep cycle order; long sequences repeat the pattern; never same color twice in a row; never random or backtracking; one color job per element; color meaning fixed network-wide; brand dominant purple/black/white. Ruled by Shawn 2026-11-01 — supersedes the PR #3141 walk.

laws.gate_check: measured bounding boxes + computed font sizes
laws.name: geometry
laws.rule: boards/cards 16:9; buttons pill; touch targets >= 44px; type >= 14px

laws.gate_check: every animated element bound to a real event kind
laws.name: alive honestly (Law 6)
laws.rule: alive means it answers touch: no halo or glow at rest; the orb carries its color as identity, solid; ignition only on interaction; motion only from real events/data; decorative ticking fails

laws.name: state completeness
laws.rule: rest, hover, pressed, selected, loading, empty, error all designed and truthful; no dead buttons, no fakes; SOON lawful only as an honest non-interactive label, never a button/tappable element; unwired renders honest frame

laws.name: family
laws.rule: one canonical component imported everywhere; never copied, never locally varied; approved pages are the element library

laws.gate_check: DOM scan for bare numerals on stats surfaces
laws.name: number carries a sentence
laws.rule: every number: magnitude + shape + direction + human sentence (SN-0822), or it does not ship

lock_in: parts ship as imports from the Factory registry
executable design gate checks this anatomy as code
every Shawn correction becomes a regression test
